answer: The basalt counter is kept in dawn and zenith shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 643 identities would post 4573 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
